public_claim_boundary: This runbook is not release-candidate validation evidence. It defines the final evidence collection procedure, but final_release_candidate_validation remains incomplete until an external release evidence JSON is supplied to validate_v1_readiness.py with every required command passed.
required_commands: git ls-files tasks_private/holdout results captures docs/reviews/panel-logs

exact-head CI succeeded for release commit
exact-head CI run ID matches exact-head CI URL
exact-head CI head SHA matches release commit
release commit pushed to intended public remote
private pack fingerprint matches validated active pack
benchmark source sha is an ancestor of release commit
working tree clean except external release evidence file
publication_rules: external release evidence is kept outside tracked public Git unless explicitly redacted
private task bodies are never published
nonpublic task identifiers are never published
private routes and seeds are never published
raw private outputs and captures are never published
local absolute paths are never published
v1-prep and v1-ready claims are not conflated
release_notes: A passing runbook check only proves that the release-candidate validation procedure is specified.
The final gate requires validate_v1_readiness.py --release-evidence <external-json> without --allow-incomplete.
